name: Camera Gimbal
description: Has an infrared mode as well as pivot controls, a variable field of view.
shortDescription: A gimbal camera with video output feed.

logicNodes.label: Infrared Mode
logicNodes.description: Controls whether or not the infrared mode is switched on.

logicNodes.label: Field of View
logicNodes.description: Controls the level of zoom of the camera.

logicNodes.label: Pivot Rotation
logicNodes.description: Controls the rotation of the camera base.

logicNodes.label: Pitch Rotation
logicNodes.description: Controls the rotation of the camera head.
